## Q1 - SEO/GEO Architecture

Build SEO/GEO as UI -> domain adapter/tools -> AI recommendation -> content store/publisher -> evaluator, with identity, credentials, schedules, ledgers, approvals, and kill-switches in shared Core. `getuai-seo` supplies the UI/MCP/AI split (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:7-11`, `:93-97`); `getuai-plugin` supplies crawler/search/competitor/keyword tool inputs (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-plugin.md:11-20`, `:117-126`); ranking comes from `getuai-seo` metrics and LLMRush GEO rank/sentiment (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:101-106`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/LLMRush.md:7-14`); content storage/publishing comes from `rankncompare` JSON/static SEO surfaces (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:28`, `:53-56`, `:128-149`). Disagreement: product-shell vs static-publisher vs Core-owned platform facts (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`). Recommendation: Core approval, override, action ledger, and kill-switch before publishing or recurring checks (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`).

## Q2 - Content Writing Architecture

Content is a staged pipeline: ideation from campaign/entity facts, outline through prompt templates, draft through LLM generation, edit/review by humans or rules, publish/send through SMTP/web/channel output, and post-publish through response/rank/attribution measurement. `getuai-email-2.0` provides Campaign CRUD, Recipients import, SMTP test, Batch create, AI generate, review, and send (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:70-73`, `:91-118`). Load-bearing choices are prompt-variable injection, recipient schema, mandatory SMTP test, human review, and session/artifact storage (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:14`, `:91-99`, `:111-118`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-api.md:24-40`). Stylistic choices are UI shape and template format. OpenClaw adds reusable generation/summarization/transcription primitives for non-email channels (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:153`, `:5104-5152`, `:6656-6716`).

## Q3 - Ads Architecture

Ads is campaign feed -> bidding/budget/targeting -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization. `getuai-ads` has the UI/MCP/AI shell and external Google Ads/DeepSeek dependencies (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads.md:7-11`, `:24-28`, `:66-100`). `getu_ads_v2` is the platform-bound mutation/query shell with stdin/file JSON, `ResultEnvelope`, failure envelopes, and 38 operations (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `:1010-1017`). `getuai-ads-data` is the platform-agnostic reporting lake for campaigns, conversions, and cross-platform sources (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads-data.md:7`, `:15`, `:159-164`, `:216-250`). Attribution is SDK -> ingress/consumer -> Pub/Sub/event tables -> dashboard (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:13-16`). Platform SDKs and mutations are isolated; ResultEnvelope, event schema, reporting lake, anomaly/pacing rules, and kill-vs-scale gates are shared. Human-in-loop is the read/write split in `lawyer_marketing` (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:248-269`).

## Q4 - Social Architecture

Social decomposes into listen, post, schedule, engage, and monitor. Listen is strongest in `reddit-scount`, which analyzes URL/company context, extracts keywords/pain points/competitors/subreddits, discovers posts, and fetches comments (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:108-121`, `:124-181`). YouTube is a search adapter (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:7-20`, `:48-54`). X post/reply/search exists through OpenClaw `xurl` (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`, `:7502-7507`). OpenClaw Gateway is the closest multi-platform abstraction: control plane, inbox, routing, sessions, tools, cron/webhooks, and per-channel adapters (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`). Quota/credit accounting comes from `x-api-credit-monitor` (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`, `:72-104`). Moderation belongs after generation and before public action, using DM pairing/allowlist gates (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:122-126`).

## Q5-Q8 Skill Catalog Summary

Q5 SEO/GEO keeps 9 rows: `seo-campaign-console`, `keyword-research-tracking`, `content-optimization`, `backlink-analysis`, `competitor-analysis`, `site-structure-analyzer`, `google-search-analyzer`, `keyword-clustering`, and protected `sitemap-robots-generator`. Canonical picks are `getuai-plugin` for reusable tools, `getuai-seo` for product shell, and `rankncompare` for static publishing (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:93-106`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-plugin.md:11-20`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:53-56`, `:134-149`).

Q6 Content keeps 8 rows: `campaign-prompt-template`, `personalized-email-draft`, `recipient-import`, `smtp-test-and-send`, `cited-websearch-copy`, `multi-model-rank-summary`, `image-text-composer`, and `summarizer-transcriber`. Brittleness controls are template variables, recipient grounding, retrieval/citations, human review, and persisted output paths (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:91-118`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:233-239`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/LLMRush.md:7-14`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:5104-5152`, `:6656-6716`).

Q7 Ads keeps 9 rows: `google-ads-cli`, `campaign-management`, `keyword-management`, `rsa-creative-management`, `budget-targeting`, protected `composite-campaign-build`, `reporting-gaql`, `attribution-ingest`, and `platform-credential-sdk`. Platform-bound Google operations are separated from platform-agnostic ResultEnvelope, attribution event, and kill criteria (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `:630-704`, `:1048-1123`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:13-16`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads-sdk.md:7-12`, `:146-161`).

Q8 Social keeps 8 rows: `reddit-opportunity-analysis`, `reddit-discovery`, `youtube-search`, `x-credit-monitor`, `x-post-reply-search`, `multi-channel-inbox`, `slack-actions`, and `channel-gating`. Every skill exposes platform difference: length, media, mention/thread ID, auth profile, quota threshold, and API-change failure (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:108-181`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:7-20`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:122-158`, `:6314-6339`, `:7392-7422`).

## Q9-Q12 Cognition Summary

Q9 SEO/GEO models: topical authority, intent mapping, E-E-A-T, GEO vs SEO, velocity vs depth. Worked/failed evidence pairs come from `rankncompare` vs `getuai-2.0`, `getuai-plugin` vs publisher-only logic, `lawyer_marketing` vs missing industry packs, LLMRush vs sitemap-only GEO, and `getuai-seo` metrics vs missing Growth Core runtime (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:128-187`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-2.0.md:19-42`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-plugin.md:11-20`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:291-317`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/LLMRush.md:7-14`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine-legacy.md:16-22`).

Q10 Content frames: user journey, portfolio theory, distribution over production, ROI window, and brand voice. They map back to Q2 pipeline and Q6 skills through campaigns/recipients/SMTP/review, OpenClaw content primitives, LLMRush measurement, and prompt-variable voice control (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:70-118`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:7-54`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:5104-5152`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/LLMRush.md:7-23`).

Q11 Ads models: LTV/CAC, pacing, creative fatigue, attribution paradox, kill-vs-scale. They work when reports, benchmarks, attribution, creative grain, and ResultEnvelope/read-write gates agree; they fail under credential drift, missing identity, campaign-average masking, and unapproved writes (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:248-304`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `:1048-1086`, `:1131-1149`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:117-186`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine-legacy.md:43-88`).

Q12 Social models: platform game theory, algorithm preference, community fit, viral mechanics, and automation visibility cost. They work when Reddit, YouTube, X, Slack, and Gateway actions retain platform-specific rules; they fail when discovery is treated as engagement or posting happens without moderation/quota controls (`runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:108-181`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:7-54`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:122-158`, `:7392-7507`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-104`).

## Q13 - Shared Foundations

Shared foundations: identity/session, credentials/secrets, data lake/artifact store, task queue/schedules, observability, LLM gateway, human-in-loop console, and repo-template conventions. Share components that enforce tenant trust, credentials, schedules, ledger/audit, observability, LLM routing, or approvals across domains; isolate domain schemas, external APIs, ranking logic, tone, and kill criteria (`growth-engine-legacy.md:43-88`; `getuai-api.md:23-42`; `attribution_v2.md:13-16`, `:153-162`; `x-api-credit-monitor.md:12-18`; `optiminds-repo-template.md:9-30`, `:55-63`, `:156-177`).

## Benchmark Answers

This section mirrors the structured `benchmark_answers` array: all 15 answers are direct and each has non-empty source citations.

benchmark_answers.answer: SEO/GEO should be built as crawler/tools -> ranking and GEO sensors -> AI recommendation -> content store -> publisher -> evaluator, with Core approval and kill-switch controls. The corpus disagrees between the three-service `getuai-seo` product shell, `rankncompare` static publisher/storage, and `growth-engine-legacy` Core-owned platform facts.

Content Writing is a campaign/entity pipeline from ideation and prompt-template outline through draft, edit/review, publish/send, and post-publish measurement. Prompt variables, recipient schema, SMTP verification, human review, and storage are load-bearing; UI/template taste is stylistic.

Ads is a campaign feed -> operation/budget control -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization loop. Platform SDKs and mutations remain platform-bound, while ResultEnvelope, attribution events, report rows, pacing/anomaly decisions, and approval/kill criteria form the platform-agnostic boundary.

Social decomposes into listen, post, schedule, engage, and monitor. OpenClaw is the closest shared routing abstraction, but adapters preserve platform-specific action grammar, quota/credit accounting, and moderation gates.

SEO/GEO has a 9-row reusable skill catalog with all 8 contract columns populated. Canonical picks are `getuai-plugin` for reusable analyzers, `getuai-seo` for the product shell, and `rankncompare` for static publishing, with duplicate functions called out.

Content has reusable skills for prompt templates, personalized drafting, recipient import, SMTP send, retrieval-grounded cited copy, model-rank summaries, image/text composing, and summarization/transcription. Brittleness is handled through variables, grounding, review, and stored outputs.

Ads has a 9-row reusable catalog covering Google Ads CLI operations, campaigns, keywords, RSA creative, budgets/targeting, composite campaign build, reporting, attribution ingest, and credential SDK. Platform-bound operations are separated from agnostic envelope, event, and kill-criteria contracts.

Social skills cover Reddit listening/discovery, YouTube search, X post/reply/search, multi-channel inbox, Slack actions, quota monitoring, and channel gating. Each skill records platform differences such as length, media, thread IDs, auth, quotas, and API-change failure modes.
SEO/GEO cognition is organized around topical authority, intent mapping, E-E-A-T, GEO-vs-SEO, and content velocity vs depth, with worked and failed evidence pairs plus anti-patterns.

Content cognition uses user journey mapping, content portfolio theory, distribution-over-production, ROI windows, and brand voice as a forcing function, with each frame linked back to Q2 architecture choices and Q6 skills.

Ads cognition uses LTV/CAC discipline, pacing, creative fatigue curves, the attribution paradox, and kill-vs-scale criteria, with break conditions around platform credentials, attribution identity, creative granularity, and unsafe writes.

Social cognition uses platform game theory, algorithm preference modeling, community fit before brand voice, viral mechanics, and automation visibility cost, validated or contested with per-platform repo evidence.

Shared foundations are identity/session, credentials/secrets, artifact/event store, queues/schedules, observability, LLM gateway, human-in-loop console, and repo-template governance. The decision rule is to share tenant-trust and control-plane contracts, while isolating domain schemas, external APIs, ranking logic, tone, and kill criteria.

The build sequence is Day-1 Core, Week-1 SEO/GEO read-only, Week-2 content, Week-4 ads read-only plus attribution, Week-8 controlled writes, and Month-3 OODA orchestration, with explicit deferrals for mutations, auto-publish, rich media, A/B automation, and autonomous spend scaling.

Recurring failures include engines owning platform facts, legacy scaffolding import, missing runtime core, credential drift, attribution/session breakage, unapproved writes, static publishing mistaken for GEO evaluation, local-only artifacts, and API prefix mismatch; each prophylactic maps to Core contracts or Q5-Q8 skills.

notes: Primary improvement targets Architecture grounding with traceable component flows for Q1-Q4.
Q5 and Q7 retain 9-row catalog margins through protected audit rows.
